title: Director of Production
text:
**Director of Production**

Location: Miami, FL

Schedule: Monday–Friday | 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM

About the Opportunity

A well-established manufacturing organization in the aviation and aerospace industry is seeking an experienced Director of Production to oversee and improve its manufacturing operations.

This is a hands-on leadership opportunity for someone with direct aerospace or aviation manufacturing experience who can manage production activities, lead teams, improve operational efficiency, and ensure consistent product quality and on-time delivery.

The ideal candidate is a practical, floor-oriented leader who understands production planning, manufacturing processes, equipment maintenance, and resource management.

Key Responsibilities

Oversee daily manufacturing and production activities to ensure operational efficiency, product quality, and timely delivery.

Manage production schedules, workflow, resource allocation, and manufacturing capacity.

Lead and coordinate production planning and maintenance teams to maintain equipment reliability and operational continuity.

Monitor production costs, operating expenses, and departmental budgets while identifying cost-saving opportunities.

Establish and track KPIs related to productivity, production volume, quality, scrap rates, lead times, and on-time delivery.

Identify opportunities to improve manufacturing processes, reduce waste, and increase production capacity.

Ensure compliance with aviation manufacturing standards, safety regulations, environmental requirements, and customer specifications.

Work closely with department managers and supervisors to establish performance goals and maintain accountability.

Coach, develop, and mentor production leaders and supervisors.

Support facility improvements, equipment upgrades, capital projects, and the implementation of new manufacturing technologies.

Promote a culture of continuous improvement, teamwork, safety, and operational excellence.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field; equivalent experience will also be considered.

Approximately 8–10 years of progressive leadership experience in a manufacturing environment.

Direct experience in aviation or aerospace manufacturing operations is required.

Previous experience managing production teams, manufacturing schedules, and operational resources.

Strong understanding of production planning, manufacturing processes, maintenance coordination, and quality control.

Experience with Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives.

Demonstrated ability to improve productivity, control costs, and meet production targets.

Strong leadership, problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making skills.

Fluency in both English and Spanish (written and spoken) is required.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with ERP systems; Quantum experience is a plus.

Six Sigma Green Belt certification or higher.

Lean Manufacturing or other continuous improvement certifications.

Experience managing manufacturing budgets and operational performance metrics.

Pay: $140,000.00 - $160,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Relocation assistance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
